78328-the-story-of-life-in-the-seas.creator: Unknown
78328-the-story-of-life-in-the-seas.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. he sea is one with so many aspects, that it is difficult to choose the points that may be included, and those that may be omitted from a book intended for the general reader.

arxiv-2209-14974.title: Greybox XAI: a Neural-Symbolic learning framework to produce interpretable predictions for image classification
arxiv-2209-14974.creator: Adrien Bennetot, Gianni Franchi, Javier Del Ser, Raja Chatila, Natalia Díaz-Rodríguez
arxiv-2209-14974.description: Abstract Although Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) have great generalization and prediction capabilities, their functioning does not allow a detailed explanation of their behavior. Opaque deep learning models are increasingly used to make important predictions in critical environments, and the danger is that they make and use predictions that cannot be justified or legitimized.

arxiv-2510-15082.title: A low-cost, open-source maskless photolithography stepper for microfabrication
arxiv-2510-15082.creator: B. Joel Gonzalez
arxiv-2510-15082.description: Abstract Abstract Photolithography is a key part of modern semiconductor process flows, and photolithography steppers have been used for decades to achieve precise patterning for device fabrication. However, these tools are often large and expensive, which restricts their use to industry and well-funded university laboratories.

arxiv-2511-17236.title: The Star Product of Uniformly Random Codes
arxiv-2511-17236.creator: Johan Vester Dinesen, Ragnar Freij-Hollanti, Camilla HollantiBenjamin Jany, Alberto Ravagnani
arxiv-2511-17236.description: Abstract We consider the problem of determining the expected dimension of the star product of two uniformly random linear codes that are not necessarily of the same dimension. We achieve this by establishing a correspondence between the star product and the evaluation of bilinear forms, which we use to provide a lower bound on the expected star product dimension.

pmc-10523745.title: Reconceptualizing Integrated Knowledge Translation goals: a case study on basic and clinical science investigating the causes and consequences of food allergy
pmc-10523745.creator: Jenna Dixon, Emily Shantz, Ann E. Clarke, Susan J. Elliott
pmc-10523745.description: BackgroundIntegrated Knowledge Translation (IKT) and other forms of research co-production are increasingly recognized as valuable approaches to knowledge creation as a way to better facilitate the implementation of scientific findings. However, the nature of some scientific work can preclude direct knowledge to action as a likely outcome. Do IKT approaches have value in such cases?

pmc-10669395.title: Types of Cell Death from a Molecular Perspective
pmc-10669395.creator: Fatemeh Hajibabaie, Navid Abedpoor, Parisa Mohamadynejad
pmc-10669395.description: Simple SummaryInflammation and free radicals can stimulate cell self-destruction. Inflammation and cell death are vital aspects of most diseases. Accumulation of cell damage leads to the impairment and dysregulation of the cell function. Thus, understanding the pathomechanism and molecular signaling pathways involved in cell death is necessary.

pmc-11295340.title: “I will find the best method that will work for me”: navigating contraceptive journeys amongst South African adolescent girls and young women
pmc-11295340.creator: Zoe Duby, Kate Bergh, Brittany Bunce, Kim Jonas, Nevilene Slingers, Catherine Mathews, Fareed Abdullah
pmc-11295340.description: BackgroundGiven that South Africa has one of the highest rates of pregnancy amongst adolescent girls and young women (AGYW) globally, the provision of contraceptives to this group has been a key focus in recent years. Pregnancy prevention involves an on-going continuum of decision-making around contraceptive method choice, uptake, use, experience, continuation, and discontinuation.

pmc-11357518.title: Plant-Derived Terpenoids: A Plethora of Bioactive Compounds with Several Health Functions and Industrial Applications—A Comprehensive Overview
pmc-11357518.creator: José S Câmara, Rosa Perestrelo, Rui Ferreira, Cristina V Berenguer, Jorge A M Pereira, Paula C Castilho, Raffaella Comitato, Eugenia Venneria, Federica Intorre
pmc-11357518.description: Terpenoids are a large class of natural secondary plant metabolites which are highly diverse in structure, formed from isoprene units (C-5), associated with a wide range of biological properties, including antioxidant, antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, antiallergic, anticancer, antimetastatic, antiangiogenesis, and apoptosis induction, and are considered for potential application in the food, cosmetics, pharmaceutical, and medical industries.

pmc-11391444.title: Novel Etch-Resistant Molecular Glass Photoresist Based on Pyrene Derivatives for Electron Beam Lithography
pmc-11391444.creator: Xue Cong, Siliang Zhang, Jiaxing Gao, Xuewen Cui, Yurui Wu, Xudong Guo, Rui Hu, Shuangqing Wang, Jinping Chen, Yi Li, Guoqiang Yang
pmc-11391444.description: Novel t-butyloxycarbonyl-protected molecular glass photoresists with pyrene as the core (Pyr-8Boc and Pyr-4Boc) were designed and synthesized. The thermal stability and film-forming ability were measured to assess their applicability for lithography. Pyr-Boc (Pyr-8Boc and Pyr-4Boc) photoresists were evaluated by high-resolution electron beam lithography (EBL), acting as chemically amplified resists.

pmc-11558489.title: Accuracy of clinical diagnosis, imaging methods, and biopsy in tumours and pseudo-tumours of the hand
pmc-11558489.creator: Fernando Ruiz Santiago, Cristian Orellana González, Beatriz Moraleda Cabrera, Antonio Jesús Láinez Ramos-Bossini
pmc-11558489.description: BackgroundThe appropriate use of imaging methods in bone and soft tissue tumours of the hand is well established in the radiological literature. However, since most of the tumoral conditions of the hand are benign, the use of imaging methods may be based on clinician preferences and technical availability.

pmc-11565593.title: Oral mucosal lesions in the mouth as first sign of dermatological diseases and disorders
pmc-11565593.creator: Harepriya Meganathan Karthikeyini, Karthik Shunmugavelu, Evangeline Cynthia Dhinakaran
pmc-11565593.description: Oral mucosal lesions manifest as a first sign of immune-mediated disorders. Lichen planus, pemphigus and pemphigoid are the most frequent immunologically mediated mucocutaneous diseases with oral involvement. Oral lesions are initially detected by dental health practitioners. Early detection can help in appropriate treatment and better quality of life.

pmc-12375117.title: Aging associated immunosenescence in rheumatoid arthritis identified by machine learning and single cell profiling
pmc-12375117.creator: Xinxin Ji, Lingyun Li, Yuanzhuo Jiao, Hui Cheng
pmc-12375117.description: Rheumatoid arthritis (RA) is increasingly prevalent among older adults, who often experience more severe symptoms and face significant treatment challenges. This study aims to identify specific genes associated with aging in RA and to analyze their immune infiltration using machine learning techniques.

pmc-12558433.title: Thermo-sensitive C3N4 for efficient photocatalytic degradation of methyl orange
pmc-12558433.creator: Xuefeng Zhu, Shikai Xue, Pingyuan Xie, Qingxian Xu, Yingxin Liu, Chengyong Li, Qiujun Lu
pmc-12558433.description: The advancement of industrialization has led to severe environmental challenges stemming from inadequate pollutant management. Photocatalytic technology has emerged as a research focus due to its eco-friendly nature and high degradation efficiency. However, the widespread application of photocatalysts is hindered by limitations in recoverability and reusability. Therefore, designing high-performance photocatalysts with facile recoverability has become a critical research direction.

pmc-12731548.title: Virtual, Nurse-Led Early Primary Palliative Care Intervention (ELICIT) for Community-Dwelling Older Adults With Cognitive Impairment: Protocol for a Randomized Controlled Trial

pmc-13062917.title: Russula nuda, a new species of Russula subsect. Xerampelinae (Russulaceae) from Japan
pmc-13062917.creator: Masaya Shimizu, Akio Tonouchi
pmc-13062917.description: A new species, Russula nuda, from Japan is described and illustrated. The species is characterized by a glabrous, white pileus with a pale brown center, a white stipe, a context that turns brown when bruised or dried, a pale olive reaction to FeSO4, a fishy odor, and globose to ellipsoid basidiospores with numerous isolated warts.

pmc-13474363.title: Comparative Analysis of Albumin-Bilirubin (ALBI) Score and Child-Pugh Score for Prognostic Stratification in Hepatocellular Carcinoma Patients: A Single-Center Experience From North India
pmc-13474363.creator: Varun Goel, Arpit Jain, Nivedita Patnaik, Dharmishtha A Basu, Prateek Gupta, Shaifali Goel, Pankaj Goel, Vineet Talwar, Shivendra Singh
pmc-13474363.description: BackgroundAccurate assessment of hepatic reserve is essential in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). While the Child-Pugh (CP) score remains widely used, subjectivity in its parameters limits reproducibility. The Albumin-Bilirubin (ALBI) score offers an objective alternative, but contemporary Indian data comparing the two remain limited.

uslaw-usc-t14-s2318.title: 14 U.S.C. § 2318 — Aviation cadets; benefits
uslaw-usc-t14-s2318.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t14-s2318.description: United States Code, Title 14 (Coast Guard); Chapter 23 (Personnel; Enlisted). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Except as provided in section 402(c) of title 37, aviation cadets or their beneficiaries are entitled to the same allowances, pensions, gratuities, and other benefits as are provided for enlisted members in pay grade E–4. While on active duty, an aviation cadet is entitled to uniforms.

uslaw-usc-t21-s1045.description: United States Code, Title 21 (Food And Drugs); Chapter 15 (Egg Products Inspection). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel.
